# Municipalities

This folder contains profiles of 16 Danish municipalities evaluated in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Atrial Fibrillation Database in Denmark (AFDK). Each page details the municipality's decentralized role in healthcare quality development, specifically tracking local compliance with national standards for Direct Oral Anticoagulant (DOAC) safety practices (Indicator 4b), early initiation of anticoagulation therapy, and ischemic stroke prevention. The data highlights significant variations in patient volumes and compliance rates across both large urban centers and smaller rural municipalities, underscoring the localized benchmarking framework of the Danish healthcare system.

## Pages

- [[broenderslev-dronninglund|Brønderslev-Dronninglund]] — Achieved the highest recorded compliance rate (97.7%) for DOAC safety practices among all municipalities in the report.
- [[fanoe|Fanø]] — Recorded an exceptional 99.1% compliance rate for DOAC safety monitoring but struggled with suppressed data on other indicators due to low patient volumes.
- [[fredericia|Fredericia]] — Met the national standard for DOAC safety practices with a 95.4% compliance rate and is tracked for early anticoagulation initiation.
- [[frederikshavn|Frederikshavn]] — Demonstrated strong performance in DOAC safety monitoring (97.7%) and early initiation of anticoagulation therapy.
- [[haderslev|Haderslev]] — Achieved a 95.9% compliance rate for DOAC safety practices and is evaluated on localized ischemic stroke prevention metrics.
- [[hjoerring|Hjørring]] — Exceeded the national standard threshold for DOAC safety practices with a 96.1% compliance rate.
- [[holstebro|Holstebro]] — Precisely met the ≥95% national threshold for DOAC safety practices and recorded compliant rates for stroke prevention.
- [[ikast-brande|Ikast-Brande]] — Successfully met the national standard for DOAC safety monitoring with a 95.4% compliance rate.
- [[kolding|Kolding]] — Recorded one of the highest compliance proportions (95.8%) for DOAC safety practices among the evaluated municipalities.
- [[langeland|Langeland]] — Distinguished as a smaller municipality reaching full standard fulfillment for DOAC safety practices with a 95.4% compliance rate.
- [[odense|Odense]] — Represented the highest proportion (96.3%) among larger municipalities for meeting DOAC safety practice standards.
- [[silkeborg|Silkeborg]] — Ranked among the highest values recorded in the report for DOAC safety practices with a 96.3% compliance rate.
- [[skanderborg|Skanderborg]] — Achieved a 96.0% compliance rate for DOAC safety practices, ranking among the highest in the report.
- [[skive|Skive]] — Demonstrated strong clinical performance by exceeding the ≥95% national standard for DOAC safety practices.
- [[struer|Struer]] — Met and exceeded the national standard requirement for DOAC safety practices with a 95.4% compliance rate.
- [[thisted|Thisted]] — Exactly met the ≥95% national standard threshold for DOAC safety practices, earning a "Yes" designation.
